sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the complete direct-static requirement: it targets ships, follows the supplied ship-to-component and pump-to-containing-compartment paths, covers all four pump alternatives, requires a QuantityValue in DEG_C, and fails when no qualifying maintained temperature strictly greater than 0 exists. It preserves the prior datatype and negated-EXISTS instructions; no repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the guessed datatype restriction `datatype(?value) = xsd:decimal`; the canonical maintainedTemperature term declares no datatype, so the check must accept the supplied numeric literal datatypes while enforcing the declared DEG_C unit and strict comparison > 0. Preserve the ship-to-component and pump-to-compartment paths and the four pump alternatives.

Repair the violation logic so the requirement is tested as the existence of a qualifying containing compartment and maintained temperature, rather than failing merely because any linked compartment or temperature value is nonqualifying. Use a negated EXISTS around the complete path `$this nltl:hasContainingCompartment ?compartment; ?compartment nltl:maintainedTemperature ?temperature`, requiring `?temperature a qudt:QuantityValue`, `qudt:unit unit:DEG_C`, and `qudt:numericValue ?value` with `?value > 0`; this also makes absence of a compartment or qualifying temperature fail without accidental passes. Preserve the ship-to-component path, the four pump alternatives, the strict `> 0` comparison, and the prior instruction not to impose a datatype restriction on `?value`.

The candidate faithfully encodes the complete direct-static requirement: it targets ships, follows the supplied ship-to-component and pump-to-containing-compartment paths, covers all four pump alternatives, requires a QuantityValue in DEG_C, and fails when no qualifying maintained temperature strictly greater than 0 exists. It preserves the prior datatype and negated-EXISTS instructions; no repair is required.
